svg.title: Magnesium glycinate vs placebo: a 1.6-point gap on an insomnia scale
svg.desc: Magnesium glycinate vs placebo: a 1.6-point gap on an insomnia scale. Placebo: -2.3 points (95% CI -4.1 to -0.4). Bisglycinate: -3.9 points (95% CI -5.8 to -2.0). p = 0.049, Cohen's d = 0.2, a small effect.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 155 adults with poor sleep, 4 weeks. Drop in Insomnia Severity Index (ISI) score; bars show 95% confidence intervals.

svg.text: Both groups improved. The gap between them was 1.6 points (p = 0.049); the authors call the effect small (d = 0.2).
